name: business
description:
Write founder planning documents that stay on evidence.

- business-plan: Use when turning a business idea into a grounded plan without inventing demand or dollars.
- market-research-brief: Use when sizing demand with cited sources.
- competitive-teardown: Use when mapping rivals for a founder plan.
- pricing-one-pager: Use when setting or defending a price.
- financial-assumptions: Use when building assumption-driven projections, not a spreadsheet replacement.
- go-to-market: Use when turning an offer into how customers find and buy it.
- pitch-narrative: Use when compressing a finished plan into a pitch.
